title: RANSAC Scoring Done Right
abstract: arXiv:2606.27385v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The most widely used RANSAC variants score a candidate model by summing per-point scores that fall to zero beyond a threshold. These scores derive from the negative log-likelihood of a Gaussian-uniform mixture. The threshold separates inliers, which follow the noise model, from outliers, and it is a function of the observation noise level, also known as the inlier scale. We remove this dependence on the threshold by reversing the usual order of RANSAC inference: rather than estimating the scale and then scoring against it, we marginalize the scale in closed form for a fixed inlier partition and then optimize over partitions. The resulting score is maximized by a single sort followed by a linear sweep. A single closed-form expression spans informative and non-informative priors, so the same score adapts to datasets with extensive or limited ground-truth annotation. translated_abstract: 最广泛使用的RANSAC变体通过对超过阈值后降为零的逐点分数求和来评估候选模型。这些分数源自高斯-均匀混合模型的负对数似然。阈值将遵循噪声模型的内点与外点区分开来，它是观测噪声水平的函数，也称为内点尺度。我们通过逆转RANSAC推断的常规顺序来消除对阈值的依赖：不是先估计尺度再据此进行评分，而是对固定的内点划分以闭式形式将尺度边缘化，然后在划分上进行优化。所得分数可通过一次排序加一次线性扫描来实现最大化。单一的闭式表达式同时涵盖了有信息先验和无信息先验，因此同一分数可适应真值标注丰富或有限的数据集。所提出的分数仅有一个超参数，即……的半宽度（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出通过在固定内点划分下以闭式形式边缘化内点尺度、再对划分进行优化来重新设计RANSAC评分，从而消除了对阈值的依赖，仅需一次排序和线性扫描即可求得最大值，且单一闭式表达式能自适应不同真值标注水平的数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper redesigns RANSAC scoring by marginalizing the inlier scale in closed form for a fixed inlier partition and then optimizing over partitions, removing the dependence on a threshold, requiring only a single sort plus a linear sweep, and using one closed-form expression that adapts to datasets with extensive or limited ground-truth annotation.
